headline: Tension between Congress and Executive
author: Óscar Coronetero
content: Luz Salgado responded to criticisms made by Prime Minister Fernando Zavalas against the majority fujimorista in Parliament, accusing him of power abuse. Consequently, she urged the prime minister to correct his undemocratic expressions.

headline: Nueva composicion ministerial
subheadline: Giuffra y Olaechea juran nuevos roles
author: Diario Correo
content: Bruno Giuffra was sworn in yesterday at Government Palace as the new head of Transportation and Communications replacing Martin Vizcarra who left due to issues related to the construction contract for Chinchero International Airport in Cusco. Meanwhile, Pedro Olaechea took over Production Ministry after serving there previously.

headline: Fiscal advances case against former president
author: Janet Leiva
content: The Public Prosecutor's Office has been actively gathering evidence regarding alleged extra-judicial killings during the presidency of Ollanta Humala known as the Madre Mia Case. Two key witnesses have now agreed to testify following assurances of protection provided by authorities.
